canonical_data: MySQL tables for chat sessions, agents, workflows, and knowledge bases with a vector database (Milvus, Weaviate, or Qdrant) for embeddings
current_repo_note: Covers the backend monorepo only. The README separates the user frontend, admin panel, copilot, drama, and mini-app repositories and a hosted commercial edition, none of which this record reviews. The same codebase also ships a short-drama service and a code generator that are not part of the agent boundary.
strengths: A coding harness ships separate approval, plan, journal, and recovery packages and a Docker command runtime, and source comments route coding skills through a policy engine and per-call approval

The agent chat mode builds a supervisor over specialist sub-agents with a Java agent library for search, SQL, charts, and skills, and a plain model-chat mode bypasses it, so the boundary between chat and agent behaviour is explicit
Self-hosted with published container images, a visual workflow designer, MCP tool support, and a pluggable vector store
weaknesses: The product sprawls across chat, workflows, knowledge bases, a coding harness, a short-drama generator, and a code generator, so no single agent loop is the documented centre
The repository bundles three Anthropic skill folders under terms that forbid copying, derivative works, and redistribution, which the MIT licence at the root does not override

The supervisor and its sub-agents are assembled inline inside one large chat facade class, which makes the agent path harder to audit, and the README lists only model, email, and manual-review workflow nodes
why_it_matters: A widely starred Chinese-ecosystem enterprise platform that pairs a conventional chat and knowledge stack with real multi-agent and guarded coding-agent code, useful as a Java-based counterpart to the Python builders.
